amendmentTiming: After new-model fitting started, before any evaluation rendering or score inspection.
reason: The older shared22-synth model already contains Boomr/Footsteppr heads. Include these as additional baselines to test actual improvement over existing engine-specific predictions, not just Transfxr transfer.
scope: Focused five-arm comparison: Transfxr mixture, shared-v2 Boomr, shared-v2 Footsteppr, independent Boomr, independent Footsteppr. This does not benchmark all other synth heads, original Bfxr search, or claim a globally best system.
selection: All candidates scored against the same audition reference; retain separate best-by-arm and unrestricted minimum. No source-synth identity enters ranking.
